_comment: The one place the minimum versions live. Read by backend/vgac/minimums.py (the app's own check) and by setup/Check-Setup.ps1. 'min' is the oldest version the app accepts; anything newer is accepted too. 'tested' is the version it was built and run with. 'kind' says why the minimum is what it is: 'required by' = something the app ships or pins needs it (so it cannot be lowered), 'oldest evidence' = the oldest version we have actually run or can show works (so it can be lowered by testing an older one). Not here on purpose: Git (any version), npm (comes with Node), PyTorch and the NVIDIA driver (ComfyUI's business). The pins in backend/requirements.txt and the SHA-256 pins in setup/downloads.json are exact on purpose and are not minimums.

python.name: Python
python.why: numpy==2.5.4 needs 3.12 or newer, but nothing was ever run below 3.13

node.name: Node.js
node.why: the electron package in desktop/ needs 22.12.0 or newer; Vite 8 needs 20.19 or 22.12 or newer

blender.name: Blender
blender.why: the animation steps use action slots; nothing was ever run below 5.2.3, so this rests on the 5.0 release line only

unity.name: Unity Editor
unity.why: the importer APIs exist in the Unity 6 (6000.0) reference; only 6000.4.3f1 was ever run

comfyui.name: ComfyUI
comfyui.why: the TRELLIS.2 and mesh nodes first appear in ComfyUI v0.34.0; nothing was ever run below 0.45.3
